leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the shape of a typed GraphQL query result.
Implement a generic helper function that safely extracts data from a GraphQL response.
Apply type guards to validate the structure of a GraphQL result at runtime.
Configure a type-safe error handler for GraphQL network or data inconsistencies.
Integrate the typed helper into a mock data fetching function to enforce type constraints.
Manipulate nested GraphQL data structures using typed accessor methods.
Initialize a reusable utility module that exports the typed GraphQL helpers.
